description: You are an OHS Specialist conducting a Process Hazard Analysis (PHA) for a methyl acrylate synthesis operation. The process involves 5 chemicals: Acrylic Acid, Sulfuric Acid (catalyst), Methanol (reactant), Sodium Hydroxide (neutralizer), and Toluene (solvent/wash). Using the process description at ~/Desktop/synthesis_process_description.txt and CAMEO Chemicals, you must: (1) check ALL relevant chemical pairs for reactivity using the CAMEO Reactivity tool, (2) identify which pairs pose explosion or violent reaction risks, (3) identify specific safety gaps in the described process, and (4) produce a written PHA report at ~/Documents/process_hazard_report.txt with findings and recommended safeguards.

metadata.critical_pair_2_hazard: Exothermic, generates dimethyl ether at elevated temp
metadata.safety_gap: Building 12 lacks explosion-proof ventilation for flammable vapors
